ABOUT US AvaLAN solves data connectivity and PCI security challenges at the network's edge for SMB and large retail enterprise customers. AvaLAN’s retail fueling centric focus is based on easy to use products with a simple dashboard allowing self-deployed networks and features like Network Segmentation, Network Access Control, and Centralized VLAN Synchronization. As a Verifone certified MNSP, as well as the leading market solution for high speed secure wired and wireless networking from the c-store to the dispenser, AvaLAN uniquely delivers PCI secure end-to-end networking for retailers. AvaLAN has a 17-year history designing communications solutions including Wireless EMV and Ethernet to Digital Current Loop specifically for the fueling industry. AvaLAN is headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama, with remote offices in Arizona, Colorado, and Canada. ​ Find out more about the Dover and AvaLAN Acquision HERE. Fill out the form on this page and a member of our team will be in touch to discuss your requirements. When scheduling a consultation with our team of experts at AvaLAN, our goal is to open up an effective dialogue to truly understand your device networking challenges. Whether we are the perfect fit or not, we will always point you in the right direction. Tell us about your requirements and we'd love to help provide our insights.
